run_finetune_convnextv2: run the ConvNeXt-V2 fine-tuning script on ImageNet with a pre-trained FCMAE checkpoint
run_eval_only: run evaluation only mode on a ConvNeXt-V2 model using the --eval flag
run_distributed_training: run distributed multi-GPU fine-tuning of ConvNeXt-V2 with gradient accumulation
run_ema_training: run fine-tuning with exponential moving average model evaluation enabled via --model_ema
run_layer_decay: run fine-tuning with layer-wise learning rate decay using single or group strategy
